description: BC L1 versioned capture: a resumable, GET-only capture of the one pinned BC Production company, My Company (book manufacturing, pinned by GUID and by the name BC lists it under; CRONUS, PLX Consol and PLX Distribution are out of scope and never read) x its company record, purchase orders/receipts/invoices, purchase credit memos, sales orders/invoices/shipments/credit memos and sales quotes (document lines per header), customers, vendors, contacts, items, customer/vendor payment journals (payment lines per journal), aged receivables and payables, the chart of accounts and item and general ledger entries (ledgers bounded per call): every BC entity set an ontology binding reads, 36 units per company, the sets the generated BC ontology binds (--generated-first: from ontology/schema/generated/meta/bc_coverage.json, never a hand list) read first in every company with their lines, into a throwaway capture store, run twice (the second pass must add no version for unchanged records), then an offline resolve of a sample of capture handles through the store and the claim_checks rows view. Output is counts, states, book keys and error classes only; never a value, number or citation. The one name is company_proof: the environment, the company name and the purchase-order count of the captured company, nothing else.
notes: live-unverified until a live-check result exists. Each pass has its own 700 s budget; a unit not finished inside it stays resumable (state in_progress, reason budget/record_cap/source_unavailable/throttled) and is reported, never counted complete. Reach is required (bc-capture-reached-floor): units_reached must equal units_total (json_same), so a last pass that the budget or a throttle stopped before every planned unit fails with 'units_reached != units_total' and records stopped_reason (budget/throttled) beside the counts (a pass-1 throttle may leave a unit deferred in pass 2, reported as stopped_reason). all_complete and units_complete stay recorded rather than required: a reached unit may still end reason-coded (not_exposed, record_cap, line_reads_failed), and they measure how much of BC one bounded run completes (document lines cost one GET per header). Every recorded run up to 2026-10-10 stopped on budget (the dailies of 2026-10-06/07/08 reached 8 to 21 units, the best hourly run 38, of the 108 now planned), so this check fails on every daily run until one 700 s pass reaches all planned units: the honest signal of the budget cut, not a flake. Its consumers (eval.order_margin, ontology.projection_bc, eval.dev_baseline) are not blocked by it and top up what it reached. Pass 2 resumes pass 1's cursors in the same store. new_versions_per_pass[1] should be near 0 (only records BC changed between the passes). A failing resolve_all_ok means a capture handle did not resolve offline; companies_captured != 1 or unpinned_companies > 0 means BC lists a company the Portal-pinned book map (integrations/bc_company_books.json, company-pins.ts@b46934a) lacks, or the pinned company was not read: a real finding, not a flake. error records only the error class and HTTP status (intermittent bc_unreadable). store_payload_bytes and per-unit payload_bytes measure growth (retention: at most 50 versions per record); this check pins --mode full (both passes read every unit in full); incremental passes are checked by bc.capture_incremental (docs/decisions/2026-10-02-bc-capture-incremental.md). A refused nextLink (reason nextlink_refused, also a nextLink that repeats a page already read in the same call, a paging cycle; see bc.capture_incremental note 2) fails this check through nextlink_refused_per_pass. Sales credit memos (salesCreditMemos + salesCreditMemoLines, the two newest units) are reported per unit like every other set (entity_set, state, records_current); their BC API v2.0 field names (creditMemoDate, invoiceId, invoiceNumber) stay unverified live until this check records those units complete. Lines units (bc-line-reads): a failed line read stays pending (not dropped); the run pauses in_progress / line_reads_failed and its next call retries exactly those headers once, so a transient failure converges to complete; a header whose retry fails too is counted dropped and the run finishes partial / line_reads_failed, so the following run is a fresh full pass; a 404 whose header also answers 404 counts as gone (lines_gone). The lines unit's error is a fixed-vocabulary class, http_<status>[:<error code>] (an enum here). Hypothesis for the 4-6 purchaseOrderLines failures on every run since 2026-10-02 (57-char label = 'SourceUnavailable: business-central GET returned HTTP <3 digits>', not 404 and not a retried 502/503/504, so a 400 or 500 on the nested navigation of the same few orders): BC fails those documents' lines server-side; the GUID-only request shape gives nothing to encode. The next run's companies[*].units[*].error on purchaseOrderLines names the status and code; if it stays in_progress/line_reads_failed across passes the failure is persistent, not transient. Finance breadth (bc-finance-2): purchaseCreditMemos + purchaseCreditMemoLines and salesQuotes + salesQuoteLines are four more units per company, and customer/vendorPaymentJournals + customerPayments/vendorPayments and agedAccountsReceivables/-Payables six more (units_total >= 93 over the three books proves they are planned). A 404 on a unit's first page (an entity set a company does not expose; a 404 on a later page stays source_refused) fails that unit with reason not_exposed (counted in units_not_exposed): a reason-coded gap that keeps all_complete false and leaves the projection's binding source_capture_incomplete, never an empty set. Their BC API v2.0 field names (purchaseCreditMemo invoiceId/invoiceNumber/creditMemoDate; salesQuote lines) and whether purchaseInvoices carry remainingAmount stay unverified live until this check records the units complete and the projection shows the values (docs/decisions/2026-10-07-bc-finance-2-payment-ledger.md). Line-read drop (bc-finance-2): a document whose nested line navigation fails is read once more by the flat line set filtered documentId eq <id> before it counts as failed (lines_via_filter per unit and per pass); only when both reads fail does the existing pending/retry/dropped path apply. If lines_via_filter stays > 0 on purchaseOrderLines, the nested navigation is what fails server-side for those orders; if purchaseOrderLines still ends line_reads_failed, both reads fail and the error class names the status. Session state (verify/live_verify.py): the session producer of {session_state}/bc-capture.sqlite, which eval.order_margin (same default capture audience and BC tenant) tops up: it reads only the units this capture did not finish. Its own check is unchanged: a session starts with an empty directory. Generated sets: the daily run of 2026-10-08 01:48Z stopped on budget after 21 units of the first company, so no run reached companyInformation, locations, unitsOfMeasure, itemCategories, currencyExchangeRates, the payment journals or their payments, and no live check named them. --generated-first roots every company on the sets the generated BC types read (and reads their lines next), so each one is named under companies[*].units[*].entity_set whatever the budget cuts later (tests/test_gen_bc.py, injected-transport). units_total counts every planned unit, per pinned company listed: each entity set, each document set's lines and the company record (36 per company), whether or not the call reached it; units_reached counts the units the call reached before a stop (the 2026-10-08 daily recorded units_total 21, the units of the first company before the budget, so the 93 floor could never be met). all_complete needs units_complete == units_total. units_total >= 93 proves only that the finance sets are planned; reach is the units_reached == units_total requirement. Unserved sets (bc-capture-incomplete-units, later ask bc-unserved-endpoints): a unit BC refuses with a 400 whose BC code is Internal_DataNotFoundFilter (http_400:internal_data_not_found_filter) while another company completed the same set in the call is unserved: it stays state failed / reason source_refused, never counts in units_complete, and is listed under unserved_units (company_index, book, entity_set, later_ask) and counted in units_unserved; its lines unit, failed with the header's reason, is listed too. Such a unit carries later_ask and accounted true; units_complete + units_unserved == units_total makes all_complete true, and complete_when asks accounted (complete or unserved) for every unit instead of state complete, so the check completes or names only the units no later ask backs. A set no company served, a 401/403 and any other BC code stay unaccounted. A lines unit open because its header unit is paused (headers_incomplete) carries the header unit's error. Injected-transport tested (integrations/tests/test_bc_capture.py); live-unverified. Production / My Company scope (bc-production-my-company-live, access record 64fca27acc88): bc_company_books.json pins Production to My Company alone and the capture reads only that company, so companies_captured is exactly 1, units_total >= 36 (the 93 floor was three companies), and the other listed companies are counted as out_of_scope_companies (not unpinned_companies, which stays 0). company_proof records environment, company name and po_count (the purchase orders the capture holds for that company once its unit is complete; the plan expects 355) and nothing else. pinned_name_mismatch > 0 means BC lists the pinned GUID under a name other than My Company: a wrong pin, the company is not read (fail closed); the GUID in bc_company_books.json was taken from the committed Portal pin and the manufacturing=My Company note, and is confirmed by this check on its first live run. salesInvoices (and its lines) are read with $filter=status ne 'Draft', so a Draft sales invoice is never captured as posted; UNVERIFIED live until this check records salesInvoices complete (a 400 shows as salesInvoices source_refused).
